baseline_acceptance.reason: The durable production rows and source bytes are unchanged; v9 adds live end-to-end execution evidence, not a data or contract change.

extends.reason: v7/v8 proved best-available-N selection (creation only) against real durable history. v9 closes the one remaining directive-required scenario neither had live evidence for: full create -> execute -> persist -> follow-up-registration on a real target, using the exact fixed create_search()/follow_up code path. v7/v8 remain valid unmodified evidence; v9 is additive, not a correction.

live_execution_evidence.method: HunterStore/execute_search() API invoked directly (the same code _pipeline_runner/run_pipeline path Run-New-Search uses) against a disposable local copy of the real production database data/hunter_searches.sqlite3; the real file was never mutated, and the disposable copy was deleted after the probe. Scorer: bayesian (no external model artifacts). Target: TIC 261136679 (pi Mensae c), a real TESS target with a documented reliable confirmed signal used elsewhere in this project's own formal acceptance evidence.
steps_proven: create_search(mode=follow-up, requested=1) created an exact pending manifest
execute_search() performed a real live MAST fetch, clean, BLS search, vet, and Bayesian score for the real target

target_search_history recorded status=candidate_found with zero error, one individual_scores row, and complete typed ExecutionProvenance (candidate_snapshot, code_version, git_commit, scorer, pipeline_context, runner)
the detected signal was registered as a follow-up recommendation (follow_ups_registered=1), joining the pre-existing durable registry
integrity_summary() remained ok with zero issues after the live write

verification.live_probe_note: The live-execution probe itself was a temporary, non-committed test file removed immediately after capturing this evidence; it is not part of the regression suite.

remaining_limitations: This is one live execution on one known-good real target with the bayesian scorer; it is a proof that the pipeline works end to end, not a broad live-scale acceptance run (see the existing 10,000-candidate / 202-target durable-history evidence in v4-v8 for scale).
xgboost/ensemble/cnn/full-ensemble scorer modes were not exercised by this probe; they were already covered by prior acceptance evidence (v1-v2) and are unaffected by the 0.3.10/0.3.11 changes.
No external submission, alert, confirmation, or discovery claim is authorized.
New-mode adaptive discovery expansion's widening loop itself (as opposed to the execution path proven here) remains offline-verified only per v8; this probe did not exercise a live 126-tile sweep.
